q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis of NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance

## (a) Time left until resolution
The earnings release is scheduled for August 26, 2026. Today is August 15, 2026. This means we have **11 days** until the forward guidance is announced.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

NVIDIA has already provided explicit forward guidance for Q2 FY2027: **$91.0 billion ± 2%**, which translates to a range of $89.18 billion to $92.82 billion.

This guidance comes directly from the company's Q1 FY2027 earnings release (per the research provided). The company typically maintains consistency in its guidance framework and only adjusts when material circumstances change. Given that:

1. NVIDIA just reported Q1 FY2027 results with record $81.6 billion revenue (up 20% sequentially)
2. The forward guidance of $91.0B represents ~12% sequential growth, which is reasonable given the 20% sequential growth they just achieved
3. This guidance was provided ~2-3 weeks ago and there's no indication of material changes to that outlook
4. The company has been explicit about China data center restrictions in this guidance

The most likely outcome is that NVIDIA will reaffirm or make only minor adjustments to this $91.0 billion guidance when they report on August 26.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- Unexpected weakness in AI accelerator demand or customer pull-forward effects exhausting
- Material loss of cloud customer orders (hyperscalers reduce capex)
- Significant supply chain disruptions
- Competitive pressure from AMD or other vendors taking market share
- Worse-than-expected macroeconomic conditions impacting customer spending
- Geopolitical developments further restricting China revenue beyond current guidance

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- Accelerating demand from new AI applications (inference, enterprise AI)
- Additional cloud customers or hyperscalers placing larger orders
- Better-than-expected mix toward higher-margin products
- Resolution or relaxation of export restrictions to China (upside not reflected in current guidance)
- New data center customers or emerging use cases driving incremental demand

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

The research provides NVIDIA's own stated guidance for Q2 FY2027: **$91.0 billion ± 2%** from their Q1 earnings release. This is the most direct "base rate" available. Additionally:

- Q1 FY2027 actual: $81.6 billion
- Sequential growth in Q1: 20%
- The 12% sequential growth implied by the $91.0B guidance is conservative relative to their recent 20% sequential expansion

Analyst consensus shows $91.8 billion with a range of $90.3B-$96.7B, which sits slightly above but very close to NVIDIA's guided midpoint.

---

## Probability Distribution

Given that:
1. We are 11 days from the actual announcement
2. NVIDIA has already provided explicit forward guidance of $91.0B ± 2%
3. Companies rarely make major changes to guidance this close to reporting
4. The question asks for "forward guidance" which will be stated in the earnings release

The distribution should be heavily concentrated around the $91.0B midpoint with modest dispersion reflecting uncertainty about whether they'll slightly raise or lower from this level.

The range provided (99.5 to 115.5B) is notably wide, which suggests potential upside scenarios where NVIDIA could guide significantly higher (perhaps reflecting stronger demand or China developments). However, the base case remains anchored to their stated guidance.

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA is expected to release its Q2 FY2027 earnings on August 26, 2026, after market close [ifyouspent.com](https://news.ifyouspent.com/en/news/nvidia-earnings-what-to-watch-august-2026). The company's own guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue is $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%, with GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins expected at 74.9% and 75.0% respectively, plus or minus 50 basis points [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/) [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). This guidance explicitly excludes any Data Center compute revenue from China [ifyouspent.com](https://news.ifyouspent.com/en/news/nvidia-earnings-what-to-watch-august-2026).

Analysts, however, have a consensus revenue estimate of $91.8 billion for Q2 FY2027, with a range between $90.3 billion and $96.7 billion [tickerleague.com](https://tickerleague.com/companies/NVDA/estimates). Some aggregators peg revenue nearer $93.5 billion [ifyouspent.com](https://news.ifyouspent.com/en/news/nvidia-earnings-what-to-watch-august-2026). The forward guide for Q3 FY2027 is frequently a significant driver of stock movement [ifyouspent.com](https://news.ifyouspent.com/en/news/nvidia-earnings-what-to-watch-august-2026). In Q1 FY2027, NVIDIA reported record revenue of $81.6 billion, up 20% sequentially and 85% year-over-year [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/) [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm).
